source.workboardProjection: current worktree; stdout-only snapshot mode; no repo artifact replaced

taskIdentity.interpretation: Partial exact crosswalk can be reconstructed for current task rows using sourceRef plus task block hash and then the generated stableKey; the stored source-index candidate field itself does not join Kanban task_id, and the snapshot is stale.

sourceIndexRefreshDryRun.interpretation: The in-memory plan has zero invalid rows and is below the indexer row cap, but the evidence census is diagnostic-only. It does not establish canonical identity; no database apply occurred.

executionReceipts.interpretation: The 32 strict verifier results validate their corresponding test receipts, not a Kanban task. Kanban attempt receipt IDs belong to a different or unresolved receipt family in this database view.

featureAuthority.interpretation: Existing feature tables are candidate/projection/domain vocabulary owners; none is a reviewed, revision-qualified canonical feature identity owner. Feature Identity V2 DDL is draft and unapplied.

verification.databaseOperations: read-only SELECTs only; all transactions rolled back

sqlQueries.latestSnapshot: SELECT snapshot_id, workspace_revision, input_checksum, source_row_count, snapshot_status, created_at FROM openspec_task_source_snapshots_v1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5;
sqlQueries.sourceIndexRowsForWorkboardJoin: SELECT source_ref, task_hash, canonical_task_key_candidate, identity_status FROM openspec_task_source_index_v1 WHERE snapshot_id = $1;
sqlQueries.kanbanRowsForWorkboardJoin: SELECT task_id, source_refs, source_revision FROM kanban_tasks;
sqlQueries.candidateToKanban: SELECT count(*) AS source_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.canonical_task_key_candidate IS NOT NULL) AS candidate_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE k.task_id IS NOT NULL) AS exact_matches, count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.canonical_task_key_candidate IS NOT NULL AND k.task_id IS NULL) AS unmatched FROM openspec_task_source_index_v1 i JOIN openspec_task_source_snapshots_v1 s USING (snapshot_id) LEFT JOIN kanban_tasks k ON k.task_id = i.canonical_task_key_candidate WHERE i.snapshot_id = 'sha256:88c34023ae0a8a0a07920b939d9c6e7ea4b080f4d828db7393d5943d0eeb24ab';
sqlQueries.duplicateCandidateValues: SELECT count(*) AS duplicate_candidate_values FROM (SELECT canonical_task_key_candidate FROM openspec_task_source_index_v1 WHERE canonical_task_key_candidate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY canonical_task_key_candidate HAVING count(*) > 1) d;
sqlQueries.receiptVerifier: SELECT count(*) AS joined, count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.verification_status = 'VERIFIED_PASS' AND v.evidence_resolved) AS verified_pass_with_evidence, count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.source_revision IS DISTINCT FROM r.source_revision) AS source_revision_mismatches, count(*) FILTER (WHERE replace(v.computed_digest, 'sha256:', '') = replace(r.report_checksum, 'sha256:', '')) AS digest_matches FROM atlas_test_execution_receipts r JOIN atlas_receipt_verifier_results_v1 v ON v.execution_receipt_id = r.execution_receipt_id;
sqlQueries.kanbanAttemptToTestReceipt: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.execution_receipt_id IS NOT NULL) AS attempt_receipt_refs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.execution_receipt_id IS NOT NULL AND r.execution_receipt_id IS NOT NULL) AS exact_test_receipt_matches FROM kanban_task_attempts a LEFT JOIN atlas_test_execution_receipts r ON r.execution_receipt_id = a.execution_receipt_id;
sqlQueries.featureCandidateCounts: SELECT 'atlas_fi_features' AS owner, count(*) AS rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE upper(status) IN ('APPROVED','CANONICAL','REVIEWED')) AS approved_or_canonical, count(DISTINCT feature_id) AS distinct_ids, count(DISTINCT source_revision) AS source_revisions FROM atlas_fi_features UNION ALL SELECT 'atlas_domain_vocabulary_crosswalk_v1', count(*), count(*) FILTER (WHERE canonical), count(DISTINCT source_value), count(DISTINCT crosswalk_version) FROM atlas_domain_vocabulary_crosswalk_v1 UNION ALL SELECT 'task_semantic_packets', count(*), count(*) FILTER (WHERE canonical), count(DISTINCT feature_id), count(DISTINCT validation_status) FROM task_semantic_packets;
sqlQueries.featureIdentityV2Presence: SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name IN ('atlas_feature_concepts', 'atlas_feature_source_identities', 'atlas_feature_concept_crosswalk', 'atlas_feature_labels');

nextRequiredWork: Refresh the OpenSpec task-source snapshot using the existing snapshot owner and pin it to a qualified source/workspace revision; retain the old snapshot.
Define an explicit, durable crosswalk between current workboard stableKey and source-index canonical task identity; reject duplicate or ambiguous candidate IDs.
Resolve the Kanban attempt receipt family to its authoritative receipt/verifier owner, then require exact receipt ID, task binding, and source revision equality.

Use the existing Feature Registry spec and Feature Identity V2 proposal as the design owner; review and admit only a small explicit set after the identity chain passes. No live DDL or rows were created here.
Add runtime admission only after current authorization, task/source revision, verified receipt, and reviewed feature binding are all joined without path/label heuristics.
likely_cause: The workboard stableKey, OpenSpec source-index candidate ID, Kanban task ID, and test receipt ID are separate identity schemes with no fully revision-qualified persisted crosswalk between them.
evidence: PostgreSQL 18.4 read-only catalog and exact-join results
safeNextCommand: Review the two reconciliation reports; then refresh only the OpenSpec source-index snapshot through its existing dry-run/snapshot owner.
